queries.label: Q1 lista de produtos: embutido many-to-one (FK composta), .or, ordem, faixa, contagem
queries.sql: select coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json) as data from (select t0."id", t0."code", t0."name", (select row_to_json(x) from (select e1."name" from public."units" e1 where e1."company_id" = t0."company_id" and e1."code" = t0."unit") x limit 1) as "unidade" from public."products" t0 where t0."company_id" = '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a' and (t0."code" ilike '%ALFA%' or t0."name" ilike '%Alfa%') order by t0."code" asc limit 10 offset 0) q

queries.label: Q1 lista de produtos: embutido many-to-one (FK composta), .or, ordem, faixa, contagem
queries.sql: select count(*)::bigint as n from public."products" t0 where t0."company_id" = '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a' and (t0."code" ilike '%ALFA%' or t0."name" ilike '%Alfa%')

queries.label: Q2 pedidos: embutidos one-to-many e many-to-one
queries.sql: select coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json) as data from (select t0."id", (select row_to_json(x) from (select e2."name" from public."customers" e2 where e2."id" = t0."customer_id" and e2."company_id" = t0."company_id") x limit 1) as "customers", (select coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(x)), '[]'::json) from (select e3.* from public."sales_order_items" e3 where e3."order_id" = t0."id" and e3."company_id" = t0."company_id") x) as "sales_order_items" from public."sales_orders" t0 limit 5) q

queries.label: Q3 upsert de produto com retorno
queries.sql: with m as (insert into public."products" ("company_id", "code", "name", "unit") select "company_id", "code", "name", "unit" from json_populate_recordset(null::public."products", '[{"company_id":"0a000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a","code":"P-NEON-ADAPTER","name":"Via adaptador","unit":"UN"}]'::json) on conflict ("company_id", "code") do update set "name" = excluded."name", "unit" = excluded."unit" returning *) select coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json) as data from (select t0."id", t0."code", t0."name" from m t0) q

queries.label: Q4 update com retorno
queries.sql: with m as (update public."products" t0 set "name" = s."name" from json_populate_record(null::public."products", '{"name":"Via adaptador (editado)"}'::json) s where t0."company_id" = '0a000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000000a' and t0."code" = 'P-NEON-ADAPTER' returning t0.*) select coalesce(json_agg(row_to_json(q)), '[]'::json) as data from (select t0."code", t0."name" from m t0) q
